name: HH-50 heavy blaster pistol
description: The HH-50 heavy blaster pistol was a large-framed heavy blaster pistol made by BlasTech Industries. Nearly the size of a blaster carbine, the HH-50 was the largest, heaviest, and most high-output blaster pistol produced by BlasTech as of the Galactic Civil War, boasting a double-barreled design that shared various parts and systems with the Clone Wars-era DC-15 blaster carbine.
